agent_skill_novelty_review.primary_source: The body is grounded in CapCut’s complete generation-to-timeline workflow guide, not a renamed earlier Skills source.
agent_skill_novelty_review.distinct_practical_action: Create one draft, inspect every scene and claim, revise timeline elements, then require approval before export.
agent_skill_novelty_review.reader_outcome: The reader obtains an editable short-video workflow with measurable revision effort and an explicit publication boundary.

complete_compiler_story.related_coverage: Selected as the edition’s only Agent Skills story after body, source, action and outcome comparison.

primary_source.title: AI Video Generation and Editing in One Workflow: How CapCut Fits

verified_read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete product guide covering web and desktop generation, timeline handoff, editable scenes, captions, audio, effects, export settings and the limits of first-party promotional workflow evidence.

visual_specification.original_image_alt_intent: A generated video draft enters an editable timeline where scenes, claims, captions, audio and pacing pass through review before a named approver unlocks export.
visual_specification.source_faithful_mechanism: CapCut’s guide shows how generated video clips move into editable timelines across its web and desktop tools, preserving access to captions, audio, pacing and export settings. The product guide is promotional first-party evidence, but it supports a bounded review sequence: generate a draft, inspect every scene, revise the timeline and export only after approval.
visual_specification.explanatory_significance: For one repeated short-video request, define the brief, generate an editable draft, inspect every scene and claim, revise captions and pacing, then require a named approver before export. Measure revision time and rejected outputs before reusing the procedure.
visual_specification.factual_scope: Reviewed the complete product guide covering web and desktop generation, timeline handoff, editable scenes, captions, audio, effects, export settings and the limits of first-party promotional workflow evidence.
visual_specification.label_authority: Owner requires explanatory text; app prepares exact wording without claiming separate owner review.
